## Summary

Describe the manuscript change in 2-4 sentences.

## Type of Change

- [ ] content revision
- [ ] figure or table update
- [ ] citation cleanup
- [ ] methods or analysis description
- [ ] workflow or tooling change

## Review Notes

- Sections changed:
- Scientific points to verify:
- Build or citation risks:

## Public Boundary Checklist

- [ ] No private contact information was added.
- [ ] No thesis, proposal, defense, weekly-report, or private planning draft was added.
- [ ] No local machine path, secret, token, or private generated artifact was added.
- [ ] No unsupported adoption, user-count, or production-use claim was added.

## Validation

- [ ] `scripts\validate_manuscript.py` was run locally or in CI.
- [ ] Evidence-table exports were regenerated if `data/` changed.
- [ ] Any CI, citation, or build failure is explained in the PR.
